_comment: Machine-readable lockfile of the PURE-PYTHON pip deps that the auto-updater may install into an installed app without a full rebuild. This is the source of truth for gen_manifest.py's pip_installs diff. Compiled/heavy deps (torch, torchaudio, demucs, madmom, faster-whisper, PyGObject, pycairo) are NOT listed here - changing them requires a full release. PyYAML is deliberately absent for the same reason: it ships a compiled wheel, and demucs already requires it. pywebview is intentionally excluded: the GUI is the user's default browser, there is no embedded webview. beartype/rotary_embedding_torch/einops are the fine-stem (mvsep_mega_fine) inference deps - all pure wheels, so the updater can deliver that model to an existing install; its weights are not shipped at all, ensure_weights() fetches them on first use. Keep in sync when adding a pure dep the app imports at runtime.
